title: Track and explicitly adopt organization governance revisions

fields.outcome: Organization consumers detect policy drift and explicitly adopt reviewed revisions; distribute signed scoped convention skills without forking agenthouse.
fields.scope: Signed offline/central policy channels, origin pins, transactional adoption, permission evaluator, portable inventory, scoped skill updates, docs and 1.9.0 release. Git/npm fetching and hosted governance are excluded.
fields.verification: tests/organization-policy.test.js, full Node suite, package checks, frozen evaluation and release workflow
fields.changes: 1.9.0: signed policy channels and scoped organization skills; see ADR-0019 and organization-policy.md
fields.evidence: 177 Node tests passed; npm run check passed; packed artifact installed offline and demo verified failing-before/passing-after behavior. Cross-platform/browser verification runs in release CI.
fields.releasePlan: Commit and push reviewed implementation; publish GitHub v1.9.0; verify cross-platform/browser workflow, npm version and attached attested bundle.
fields.rollbackPlan: Do not reuse npm versions. Publish a corrective patch if required. Consumers retain existing exact runtimes until explicit update; policy adoption uses transactional recovery.

criteria.text: Two consumers observe drift without automatic adoption
Unknown/withdrawn authority never passes a required permission check
Adoption requires reviewed digest and preserves local changes on conflict
Organization publishers cannot replace reserved dependencies or exceed trust scope
Signed skill updates respect compatibility, integrity and pins
Existing snapshots remain compatible; offline operation uses no hidden fetch
